parameters.help_en: Source Prometheus instance ID of the aggregation task group
parameters.help_zh: 聚合任务组的源 Prometheus 实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.example:
groups:
- name: "node.rules"
  interval: "60s"
  rules:
  - record: "node_namespace_pod:kube_pod_info:"
    expr: "max(label_replace(kube_pod_info{job=\"kubernetes-pods-kube-state-metrics\"\
      }, \"pod\", \"$1\", \"pod\", \"(.*)\")) by (node, namespace, pod, cluster)"
parameters.help_en:
Aggregation task group configuration.
Currently only the "RecordingRuleYaml" format is supported, which must conform to the RecordingRule format requirements of open-source Prometheus
parameters.help_zh:
聚合任务组配置。
目前仅支持 “RecordingRuleYaml”  格式，要求符合开源 Prometheus 的 RecordingRule 的格式要求
parameters.name: agg_task_group_config

parameters.help_en: Aggregation task group configuration type. Default: "RecordingRuleYaml" (open-source Prometheus RecordingRule format)
parameters.help_zh: 聚合任务组配置类型，默认 “RecordingRuleYaml”（开源 Prometheus 的 RecordingRule 格式）
parameters.name: agg_task_group_config_type

parameters.help_en: The specific scheduling expression when the scheduling mode is set to "Cron". For example, "0/1 * * * *" means scheduling every 1 minute starting from minute 0
parameters.help_zh: 调度模式选择“Cron”情况下，具体的调度表达式。例如“0/1 * * * *”，表示从 0 分开始，每隔 1 分钟调度一次
parameters.name: cron_expr

parameters.help_en: Fixed delay time for scheduling. Unit: seconds. Default: 30
parameters.help_zh: 调度的固定延迟时间。单位：秒，默认30
parameters.name: delay

parameters.help_en: Second-level timestamp corresponding to the scheduling start time
parameters.help_zh: 调度开始时间对应的的秒级时间戳
parameters.name: from_time

parameters.help_en: Maximum number of retries for executing aggregation tasks. Default: 20
parameters.help_zh: 执行聚合任务的最大重试次数，默认 20
parameters.name: max_retries

parameters.help_en: Maximum retry duration for executing aggregation tasks. Unit: seconds. Default: 600
parameters.help_zh: 执行聚合任务的最大重试时间，单位：秒，默认 600
parameters.name: max_run_time_in_seconds

parameters.help_en: Pre-check configuration. Not configured by default. The input string must be valid JSON
parameters.help_zh: 预检测配置，默认不配置。输入的字符串需要能被正确 JSON 解析
parameters.name: precheck_string

parameters.help_en: Scheduling time expression. "@s" or "@m" is recommended, indicating the granularity of scheduling time window alignment. Default: "@m"
parameters.help_zh: 调度时间表达式，推荐 “@s” 或者 “@m”，表示调度时间窗口对齐的粒度，默认 “@m”
parameters.name: schedule_time_expr

parameters.help_en: Aggregation task group status. "Running" or "Stopped". Default: Running
parameters.help_zh: 聚合任务组状态，“Running” 或者 “Stopped”。默认 Running
parameters.name: status

fields.help_en: Key of the resource group tag
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: Value of the resource group tag
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: Target Prometheus instance ID of the aggregation task group
parameters.help_zh: 聚合任务组的目标 Prometheus 实例ID
parameters.name: target_prometheus_id

parameters.help_en: Second-level timestamp corresponding to the scheduling end time. 0 means scheduling will not stop
parameters.help_zh: 调度结束时间对应的秒级时间戳，0 表示不停止调度
parameters.name: to_time

parameters.help_en: Whether to override and update when a resource with the same name exists during aggregation task group creation
parameters.help_zh: 创建聚合任务组时，存在同名资源是否覆盖更新
parameters.name: override_if_exists
